subject.title: Feature request: per-group debounceMs for WhatsApp (and other channels)

question: Should OpenClaw add a public WhatsApp `channels.whatsapp.groups.<jid>.debounceMs` override, and should that be WhatsApp-only or part of a broader cross-channel group debounce contract?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the fix adds a public config surface whose precedence and cross-channel scope require maintainer product intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve narrow WhatsApp override
options.body: Add `debounceMs` only to WhatsApp group config, with group value taking precedence over account, channel, and global inbound debounce plus focused tests/docs.

options.title: Defer to cross-channel design
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers define one shared group debounce contract for WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and other group-capable channels.

options.title: Reject the config surface
options.body: Document the existing account/channel debounce and routing-agent workaround instead of adding another config key.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow WhatsApp override
recommendation.body: Add `debounceMs` only to WhatsApp group config, with group value taking precedence over account, channel, and global inbound debounce plus focused tests/docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original WhatsApp debounce feature and have adjacent shared debouncer/config history plus prior review context on this issue.
